description: A null keyword element unified with a map element stays a null of the dynamic pseudo-type
notes: The spec says the dynamic pseudo-type unifies with any other type to that type, so the element should become a null map of strings. go-cty gives up on element types that are all maps or dynamic and chooses the dynamic pseudo-type (unifyCollectionTypes, which calls unifyAllAsDynamic, in cty/convert/unify.go), while a number element and a dynamic element unify to number (unify-null-keyword-element-with-number). An implementation whose nulls all have the dynamic pseudo-type would pass regardless, hence typed-values.
